question: Rhode Island's District Court and Superior Court expungement forms both instruct the participant to bring an Order for Expungement or Sealing of Record to the hearing, and Rhode Island publishes no order template. May LegalEase compose it?
decision: APPROVED. LegalEase may compose the Rhode Island proposed orders.
legalFunction: The participant supplies a proposed order for the hearing. The court alone makes the findings, grants or denies relief, determines any compliance terms, signs the order and enters it, and may sign, modify, reject or replace what the participant brought. The clerk's later preparation of certified copies is a post-grant function and does not make the clerk the pre-hearing drafter.
courtSpecificVariantsRequired: Superior Court felony and deferred-sentence routes
stateChange: All five moved SOURCE_BLOCKED to SOURCE_READY. Every source each family names now binds by held bytes.

outputApproval.required: Counsel review of the exact generated canonical and boundary proposed orders, before commercial route opening.
outputApproval.whyItDoesNotHoldTheBuild: It is an output gate on generated bytes, so it cannot be answered until the bytes exist. Build, deterministic rebuild, raster and independent review proceed; the route does not open until counsel has read the exact orders.
